description: Search the integrity-mapped public What Happened catalog by topic, ID or title. Returns matching summaries, canonical links, source IDs and review-copy references/hashes; private archives are not searched. No authentication required. Call get_public_story_record with a returned story_id to read one mapped packet; no match is not proof that no private record exists.

max_results.description: Optional match limit from 1 to 10; defaults to 5.

query.description: Required public-record search text, 2–240 characters; IDs, titles and subject terms are accepted.

name: search_public_story_records
title: Search Cassie Hour public records
